entries.title: Editorial Studio reorganized into focused workflow tabs
entries.summary: The private Editorial Studio was reorganized from one long scrolling page into a focused two-tier workspace consistent with the Civic Portal. Publishing, Civic Wire, Insights, and Archive now form the primary workflows, with contextual tools for drafts, publications, ticker rotation, notices, weather, sources, traffic, and WordPress archive operations. Only the selected workspace is displayed, unfinished form content remains available while switching tools, direct links preserve the selected view, and keyboard and mobile navigation are supported. Existing authorization, editorial records, ticker content, and public data were not changed by this interface release. All 78 release tests passed before publication.
entries.sourceLabel: The Utopian Society private Editorial Studio

changes: Added workflow-level tabs for Publishing, Civic Wire, Insights, and Archive
Added contextual secondary tabs for each workflow
Displayed only the selected tool panel to reduce page length and distraction
Preserved unfinished draft, notice, weather, and source form state between tab changes
Added section and view query parameters for refreshable and bookmarkable tool links
Added arrow-key, Home, and End navigation with explicit tab semantics
Made both navigation tiers horizontally scrollable on narrow screens
Routed existing ticker edit and configuration actions directly to their correct tool panels
Preserved server-side editorial authorization and made no civic-record or ticker-content mutation
